note: TASK-683 middle purple (NGM) route replay: NG1's TASK-675 inputs mirrored (NGM is NG1 reflected about its zone centre, so every aim fraction f becomes 1 - f). Fixture: zero-speed drop 300 above the approach ledge (NGM-APPROACH) at 80% of its top. Tick 1: pull toward the approach's own top just right of the player, released at the bounce (tick 44): the player leaves the ledge moving right and falls into the purple zone. Tick 545-565: a press inside the zone (aimed at NGM3) that must stay blocked. Tick 850: a fresh press after exit grapples the exit ledge and pulls the player onto its top.
